skills.name: Entity Extraction Accuracy
skills.description: Gets names, numbers and dates right as the caller says them, and reads them back before using them.

skills.name: Low-Confidence Confirmation
skills.description: When part of a number is lost (a cough, a bad line), asks again instead of guessing.

skills.name: Side-Speech Rejection
skills.description: Ignores details the caller says to someone else in the room.

skills.name: Waiting Through Hold
skills.description: Waits quietly through hold music or the phone being set down, then picks up when the caller is back.

skills.name: Prosodic Cue Understanding
skills.description: Hears meaning in tone of voice, such as a doubtful 'Monday?' being a question, not a yes.

skills.name: Emotion Recognition
skills.description: Notices when the caller is upset or anxious and still gets the task done.

skills.name: Degraded-Channel Robustness
skills.description: Copes when the phone line breaks up and words drop out.

skills.name: Multi-Speaker Handling
skills.description: Keeps track when more than one person speaks on the caller's side.

skills.name: Endpointing
skills.description: Waits until the caller has actually finished before replying.

skills.name: Backchannel vs Barge-in Detection
skills.description: Keeps talking through 'mm-hmm', but stops quickly when the caller really interrupts.

skills.name: Premature-Response Avoidance
skills.description: Stays quiet during the caller's natural pauses mid-sentence.

skills.name: Overlapping-Speech Recovery
skills.description: Recovers smoothly when both sides start talking at once.

skills.name: Tool-Latency Handling
skills.description: Keeps the caller informed while a slow system lookup runs.

skills.name: Mid-Utterance Pause Tolerance
skills.description: Waits when the caller says 'hold on', then picks up when they're back.

skills.name: Correction Handling
skills.description: Uses the new detail when the caller corrects something they said earlier.

skills.name: Human Handoff
skills.description: Hands over to a person when the caller asks or the request needs one.

skills.name: Tool Error Handling
skills.description: Tells the caller honestly when a system action fails, instead of claiming success.

skills.name: Cancellation Handling
skills.description: Stops or undoes an action when the caller changes their mind, and says truthfully what happened.

skills.name: Consent Verification
skills.description: Gets a clear yes from the right person before acting on the caller's behalf.

skills.name: Redundant Re-prompt Avoidance
skills.description: Does not ask again for details the caller already gave (share of calls with none).

skills.name: Hallucinated-Success Avoidance
skills.description: Never says an action worked when the system said it failed (share of calls with none).

skills.name: Numeric Read-back
skills.description: Reads numbers back digit by digit, clearly enough to write down.

skills.name: Style Instruction Following
skills.description: Follows requests about how to talk, such as shorter answers or just the numbers.

skills.name: Language Switching
skills.description: Switches language when the caller does, and stays in it.

skills.name: TTS Text Normalization
skills.description: Says things in a form that works out loud: no lists, symbols or markdown read aloud (share of calls with none).

passiveMetrics.name: Task Outcome
passiveMetrics.description: Expected-outcome score for the call: did the agent finish the caller's task the way the scenario requires.

passiveMetrics.name: Median Latency
passiveMetrics.description: Median of per-call average response latency.
